page.overview:
Who is Benjamin?

Benjamin was a kid who was woken-up by the disorientated male Tyrannosaur Buck wandering in his back yard during the San Diego Incident.

He called his parents, who at first didn't believe him. They were stunned to see the dinosaur, who had just eaten the family dog. He took a picture of the T. rex with his camera causing it to roar and his parents scream in horror as he runs off. He was played by Colton James.

Benjamin has brown hair And brown eyes,He wears a blue long sleeved football pajama shirt and wears shorts.

BENJAMIN: There's a dinosaur in our back yard.
